source.section: IT 1040 lines 1 to 8a (bundle PDF p.1); booklet PDF p.16 lines 1 to 4; PDF p.17 line 4 exemption table and line 8a; PDF p.18 bracket table; PDF p.5 rounding; MAGI PDF p.8; MAGI less exemptions worksheet PDF p.40

worked: Federal AGI = wages person 0 80,001.00 = 80,001.00. Federal taxable income = 80,001.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 64,251.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Ohio starts from federal AGI). IT 1040 line 1 federal AGI 80,001.00. Schedule of Adjustments additions: line 1 non-Ohio state or local interest 0.00; line 12 total 0.00; line 2a 0.00. Deductions: none; line 47 total 0.00; line 2b 0.00. Line 3 Ohio AGI = 80,001.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 = 80,001.00. Line 4: MAGI is line 3 with no business income deduction, 80,001.00, in the band 80,001 to 749,999: 1,900.00 each; 1 exemption x 1,900.00 = 1,900.00. Line 5 = 80,001.00 - 1,900.00 = 78,101.00. Line 6 taxable business income 0.00. Line 7 = 78,101.00. Line 8a tax: 78,101.00 is in the 26,050 to 100,000 band: 342.00 plus 2.750% of (78,101.00 - 26,050.00 = 52,051.00) = 342.00 + 1,431.4025 = 1,773.4025; to the cent 1,773.40. Schedule of Credits line 1 = 1,773.40. MAGI less exemptions (worksheet PDF p.40) = 80,001.00 - 1,900.00 = 78,101.00 (equal to line 7 without business income), under 100,000.00. Line 2 retirement income credit: no covered retirement income, 0.00. Line 4 senior citizen credit: no one is 65 or older, 0.00. Line 10 credits = 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00. Line 11 = 1,773.40 - 0.00 = 1,773.40. State income tax 1,773.40. The form works in whole dollars ('Round all figures to the nearest dollar', PDF p.5): line 8a would be 1,773; expected keeps the formula result. One dollar over 80,000 falls to 1,900, as the row '$80,001 - $749,999' prints.
